themes.evidence: Each day, our employees around the world work together for patients – it drives everything we do.
We work every day to deliver innovative medicines for patients with serious and life-threatening diseases.
We are focused on helping millions of patients around the world in disease areas such as oncology, cardiovascular, immunoscience and fibrosis.
As global citizens, we work sustainably, responsibly and seek to give back.

linguistic_shift: The tone has shifted from a broad statement of the company's strategy to a more focused discussion of the company's mission and impact on patients.
analyst_notes: A researcher should verify the company's commitment to delivering shareholder value and the specific achievements mentioned in the 'Achievements' section.
